name: recall_two_hop_none_deref
about: find_user now returns None for a missing id instead of raising. Its direct caller only passes the value along, so the break is not there: it is in greet(), two calls away, which reads .name on the result. Findable only when the context follows callers past the first step.
diff:
diff --git a/users.py b/users.py
--- a/users.py
+++ b/users.py
@@ -2,4 +2,4 @@
 
 
 def find_user(uid):
-    return USERS[uid]
+    return USERS.get(uid)

findings.title: find_user now returns None for a missing id, and greet() two calls away reads .name on it
